items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: We had Louie Armstrong and his band, Mr. Bill Robinson, The Delta Rhythm Boys, The Peter Sisters, Maurice Rocco, and the Nicholas Kids.

ctx.x: He books me into the Zanzibar. Remember the Zanzibar in New York? It was a big show. Now here's the show we had at the Zanzibar.
We had Louie Armstrong and his band, Mr. Bill Robinson, The Delta Rhythm Boys, The Peter Sisters, Maurice Rocco, and the Nicholas Kids. Now that's enough show to run you crazy.
Claude Hopkins in the Zanzibar. We're coming out of Washinton, D.C.. We come in there Friday morning at 9:00
